svg.title: How a delegated task runs
svg.desc: A caller delegates a task. The task service checks policy and writes the task, its audit intent and an outbox event in one store transaction. The runtime asks the policy again before it dispatches, runs the agent handler, and the outbox relay carries the outcome to the user's inbox. a delegated task: Caller → LocalApp → TaskService → Store → Runtime tick → Agent handler → Store → Outbox relay → Inbox. policy checked at accept: TaskService → Policy (PDP). policy checked again at dispatch: Runtime tick → Policy (PDP).
